{{Quote|You&hellip;You&hellip;You&hellip;''"<br />"''You want unpleasant things to happen to me, too?|Dominic Raynor and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LL">{{Tales|3|Lady Luck (comic story)}}</ref>}}
An '''ambush''' was set up by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] in order to capture [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who had come into possession of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] by winning it from [[Dominic Raynor]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. Raynor, who believed that Calrissian had cheated him, hired Bossk to take his revenge on the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]. Knowing that a direct assault would be pointless, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter prepared a trap for the new Administrator. Bossk led a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group to the lower levels of the [[City/Legends|city]] and [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] some equipment on a maintenance level to draw down Calrissian. Though the Baron Administrator was cautious enough to bring several [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|troopers]] with him, he was trapped and cut off from communications when a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] was shut behind him. Calrissian escaped through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt did not deter him from managing Cloud City.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Lando Calrissian&hellip; you believe you can ''beat'' me?''"<br />"''Winning is secondary, Baron. I just enjoy the games.|Dominic Raynor and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LL" />}}
[[File:Raynor-LadyLuck.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Calrissian reveals his cards to Raynor.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a professional [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], played the card game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] in the [[Trest]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Calrissian's playing caught the attention of [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Dominic Raynor]], who invited Calrissian for a game in the [[Ecclessis Figg Room]]. They played a high-stakes game, and Calrissian lost all his cash and his private [[Mu-2 long range shuttle|''Mu''-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Cobra]]''. After the match, [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] liaison [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[City/Legends|city]], revealed that the game had been rigged by the dealer.<ref name="LL" />

The match still counted as a loss for Calrissian, but he and Raynor played again, as Lobot gave the gambler a gift from workers of the city: a sum of five million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. This time, however, Lobot, with the assistance of Raynor's consort [[Ymile]], who hated living in the city, rigged the match in favor of Calrissian. The gambler risked all five million credits and his remaining [[Starship/Legends|starships]] against Raynor's two million credits and Cloud City, and Calrissian won.<ref name="LL" /> The former Baron Administrator was convinced that the [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] had cheated during the game and vowed to get his money back. Using his contacts, Raynor hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to hunt down Calrissian and exact revenge.<ref name="SLR" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|Enjoy it while you can, Calrissian!|Dominic Raynor|<ref name="LL" />}}
[[File:Bossk-SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|px150|Bossk set up an ambush for Calrissian.]]
Knowing that his target, the new Baron Administrator, would be well-protected, Bossk brought a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and cutthroats&mdash;a [[Unidentified Twi'lek 1 (Ambush in Cloud City)|Twi'lek scoundrel]], [[Unidentified Twi'lek 2 (Ambush in Cloud City)|another scoundrel]] of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[Unidentified Quarren (Ambush in Cloud City)|Quarren assassin]], and a [[Unidentified Duros (Ambush in Cloud City)|Duros mercenary]]&mdash;to help him deal with any problems that might arise. After the group evaded Cloud City's security, Bossk [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] some vital equipment to set up the ambush in one of the city's maintenance decks. The Trandoshan was not sure of which [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] Calrissian would arrive in, so he split his men up into every room near the lifts. Bossk ordered the others to take cover but remain in sight so they can lure Calrissian out. They intended to quickly [[Death/Legends|kill]] any [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]] with the Administrator and capture Calrissian before he could find a way to escape.<ref name="SLR" />

After the hunters took their position, Bossk hacked into the city's computer and, impersonating the [[Cloud City chief engineer|chief engineer]], he sent an urgent message to Calrissian. The Trandoshan claimed that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod was about to break down, risking the entire city plunging through the clouds of Bespin. Calrissian responded to the call at once, bringing four [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]] and a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek bodyguard|Twi'lek bodyguard]] with him.<ref name="SLR" />

After Calrissian and his guards entered the maintenance level, a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] suddenly shut behind them. They found themselves trapped in a dark and steamy room and they immediately came under [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] from Bossk's bounty hunter group. The repulsorlift machinery's interference prevented Calrissian from calling for reinforcements through his [[Wrist link/Legends|wrist link]]; and the maintenance deck's communication stations were not working, either, due to Bossk's sabotage. Knowing that another access port was nearby, Calrissian realized he had no choice but to fight and try to make his escape through the nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="SLR" />

Meanwhile, a quartet of loyal wing guards alerted by the sound of firefight were on their way to help the Baron Administrator. A member of Calrissian's party got to the nearby flight control center and sent out a distress call to the Security Headquarters. The arrive of the four additional wing guards helped Calrissian to escape through the nearby hangar bay.<ref name="SLR" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Lando13.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The security of the Baron Administrator was strengthened after the assassination attempts.]]
Since Bossk's ambush was unsuccessful, Raynor hired other beings to kill Calrissian, but the security of of the Baron Administrator was tightened with every attempt. After a [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] assassin also failed, Raynor sent a [[Human replica droid]] impersonating [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] of [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], one of Calrissian's former lovers, to kill the gambler. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was led to the Administrator's personal office, but again, the assassination attempt failed.<ref name="IA">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

After that attempt, Calrissian got the idea of drawing out his opponent by playing dead. Calrissian assumed that, after the news of his "death" was spread, Raynor would come to Cloud City to buy the floating colony. Until then, Calrissian and Lobot traveled aboard the ''Cobra'' to the [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] to hide. There, however, they were ambushed by the female bounty hunter [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]] and her modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], the [[Starlight Red|''Faceted'']]. They escaped to [[Quilken/Legends|Quilken]], and with the help of [[Mungo Baobab]]&mdash;heir of the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]]&mdash;they captured Thune. Calrissian and Baobab used Thune as blackmail in order to capture Raynor, who was interrogated by [[Bwahl]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] until he dropped his vendetta.<ref name="IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Bossk has been hired to capture or kill Lando and will stop for nothing to accomplish this. If the Bounty Hunter player defeats the Twi'lek Bodyguard and the four Bespin Guards, and can establish line of sight to Lando Calrissian before Lando manages to escape to the other side, the Bounty Hunter player wins the scenario.|''Sore Loser's Revenge''|<ref name="SLR" />}}
[[File:SWMdeathstarmap.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A possible place of the ambush]]
The ambush on Cloud City appeared in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', a [[Wizards.com]] online scenario for the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game. The scenario was written by [[Eric Cagle]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]] and published online on [[October 8]], [[2004]]. The scenario suggested to play on the [[Tractor beam/Legends|Tractor Beam]] Reactor Coupling map. Bossk captures Calrissian in an alternate ending to the scenario,<ref name="SLR" /> but the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'' has rendered this ending non-[[canon]] by featuring Calrissian unharmed a few days after Bossk's ambush.<ref name="IA" />
